UST is a mission-driven technology company that creates digital experiences and technology solutions for clients and partners. The Junior Full Stack Developer will build end-to-end data-driven applications and APIs, integrate them with enterprise data platforms, and collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and architects. The role also involves design discussions, code reviews, debugging, testing, and adherence to modern engineering practices such as CI/CD.
Enterprise Software
Healthcare
Payments
Medical
No H1B
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain end-to-end full stack applications (frontend + backend)
Build scalable data-driven applications and APIs
Integrate applications with enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, APIs)
Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and architects
Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and debugging
Ensure code quality, testing, and adherence to modern engineering practices (CI/CD)

Required
·       Graduation Year: 2024, 2025 or 2026
·       GPA: 3.5
·       Experience: 0-3 years
·       Frontend: React / Angular / Vue.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript
·       Backend: Java / Python / Node.js
·       APIs: REST / Microservices architecture
·       Cloud: Exposure to AWS / Azure / GCP
·       Basic understanding of data pipelines, ETL, and data modeling concepts
·       Ability to work with data APIs and analytics-driven use cases
·       Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science or related field
·       Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and system design
·       Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
·       Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
·       Strong learning agility and ownership mindset
·       Good communication (technical + business stakeholders)
Preferred
·       Candidates from top-tier universities (e.g., MIT, Stanford, CMU, UC Berkeley, etc.) or equivalent strong institutions preferred
·       Internship/work experience with leading tech/product companies (e.g., Google, Microsoft, Amazon, etc.)
·       Exposure to data platforms, analytics, or modern data ecosystems
·       Contributions to open source, hackathons, or research projects
·       Exposure/interest in AI/ML-driven or data-centric applications (nice to have)
·       Tools: Git, CI/CD, Docker (good to have)
·       Databases: SQL (Postgres/MySQL) + NoSQL (MongoDB preferred)
Benefits
Full-time, regular employees accrue a minimum of 10 days of paid vacation per year.
Full-time, regular employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year, pro-rated for new hires throughout the year.
Full-time, regular employees receive 10 paid holidays.
Full-time, regular employees are eligible for paid bereavement leave and jury duty.
Full-time, regular employees are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching.
Full-time, regular employees and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Full-time, regular employees receive Company-paid Employee Only basic life insurance.
Full-time, regular employees receive Company-paid Employee Only accidental death and disability insurance.
Full-time, regular employees receive Company-paid Employee Only short- and long-term disability benefits.
Regular employees may purchase additional voluntary short-term disability benefits.
Regular employees may participate in a Health Savings Account (HSA).
Regular employees may participate in a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for healthcare, dependent child care, and/or commuting expenses as allowable under IRS guidelines.
Part-time employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year, pro-rated for new hires throughout the year.
Part-time employees are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer matching.
Full-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year, pro-rated for new hires throughout the year.
Full-time temporary employees are eligible to participate in the Company’s 401(k) program with employer matching.
Full-time temporary employees and their dependents residing in the US are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance.
Part-time temporary employees receive 6 days of paid sick leave each year, pro-rated for new hires throughout the year.
All US employees who work in a state or locality with more generous paid sick leave benefits than specified here will receive the benefit of those sick leave laws.
